title: Saffron Air SF-103 cancelled - short-notice cancellation, nothing refunded

dispute.narrative: My Saffron Air flight SF-103 BOM-GOI was cancelled. I have not received what I am owed.

documents.title: E-ticket / itinerary receipt
documents.text:
E-TICKET / ITINERARY RECEIPT
Passenger: Divya Menon
Booking reference (PNR): GQ496R
Flight: SF-103 BOM-GOI departing 04-Sep-2026 17:00 IST
Base fare INR 4,200.00 | Fuel charge INR 750.00 | Taxes and fees INR 810.00
Total paid INR 5,760.00 by credit card

documents.title: Cancellation SMS
documents.text: Dear Divya, Saffron Air regrets that flight SF-103 BOM-GOI scheduled 04-Sep-2026 17:00 IST is cancelled. Sent 03-Sep-2026 21:00 IST.

agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking GQ496R on SF-103; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Saffron Air: I request INR 10,710.00 for the cancellation of SF-103 (PNR GQ496R) on 04 Sep 2026.
review_notes: Citations to be checked against regulation text.
citations: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV - compensation in addition to refund when a cancellation is notified less than 24 hours before departure
CAR Section 3 Series M Part II - refunds within 7 days for credit card purchases
